invariants: Every source event must be represented exactly once in an event_unit or an explicit approved exclusion.
Every event_unit has a unique unit_id, one or more source_event_ids, and a canonical_event conforming to EVENT_MODEL_SCHEMA.
Each BASE state-change node has at most one owning event unit per chapter; node_owners must exactly match event_units.owned_state_nodes.
Merged units preserve all source_event_ids and require a new derived Event ID.
An excluded source event requires a non-empty reason and approved=true; exclusions are not silent drops.
provenance_rules: Every source Event must carry one P13C EventDecisionPlan or host-authored NO_AGENT_DECISION_REQUIRED receipt ref in its Artifact Envelope; event_units aggregate these refs without putting custom fields into canonical_event.
Every asset phase referenced by a source Event must appear in event_units.asset_phase_refs as {asset_id, phase, target_chapter, source_opportunity_plan_ref}; preserve all mappings on merge.
All P10 confirmed causal relationship candidate_refs consumed by source Events must be preserved in source_relationship_ids; no relationship is lost on merge.
Merging is invalid if it drops a unique decision plan, asset phase, relationship, or independent actor choice.
